# Functions References {#sec-functions}

# Functions Reference {#sec-packages-functions-reference}

This table consolidates the packages and commands used throughout the book, what each command does, and where it is first introduced.




::: {.cell}
::: {.cell-output-display}


|Package        |Command                   |What it does                                                                     |First introduced           |
|:--------------|:-------------------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:--------------------------|
|base R         |`$`                       |Accesses or creates columns within a data frame.                                 |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`:`                       |Creates integer sequences (e.g., `1:10`).                                        |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`<-`                      |Assigns values to objects for later use.                                         |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`?function_name`          |Accesses built-in help documentation for a function.                             |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`[]`                      |Indexes and subsets elements from vectors or data frames.                        |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`c()`                     |Combines multiple values into a single vector.                                   |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`class()`                 |Identifies the data type (class) of an object.                                   |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`colnames()`              |Displays or modifies column names of a data frame.                               |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`data.frame()`            |Combines vectors into a tabular data structure.                                  |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`factor()`                |Converts character data into categorical (factor) variables.                     |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`getwd()` / `setwd()`     |Gets or sets the current working directory.                                      |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`head()` / `tail()`       |Displays the first or last rows of a dataset.                                    |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`install.packages()`      |Installs packages from CRAN.                                                     |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`length()`                |Returns the number of elements in a vector.                                      |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`levels()`                |Displays the levels associated with a factor.                                    |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`library()`               |Loads an installed package into the current R session.                           |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`log()` / `log10()`       |Computes natural and base-10 logarithms.                                         |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`nrow()` / `ncol()`       |Returns the number of rows or columns in a dataset.                              |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`read.csv()`              |Imports CSV files into R as data frames.                                         |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`round()`                 |Rounds numeric values to a specified number of digits.                           |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`sqrt()`                  |Computes square roots.                                                           |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`str()`                   |Displays the internal structure and data types of a dataset.                     |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`summary()`               |Produces descriptive summaries of variables or model results.                    |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`table()`                 |Creates frequency tables for categorical data.                                   |[Introduction to R](#sec-intro-key-functions)|
|base R         |`is.na()`                 |Identifies missing (`NA`) values.                                                |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|base R         |`sessionInfo()`           |Displays information about the current R session, including loaded packages.     |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|base R         |`|>`                 |Passes the result of one operation into the next.                                |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`arrange()`               |Orders rows based on column values.                                              |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`case_when()`             |Applies multiple conditional rules.                                              |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`count()`                 |Counts observations by group.                                                    |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`distinct()`              |Returns unique rows or value combinations.                                       |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`filter()`                |Keeps rows that meet logical conditions.                                         |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`group_by()`              |Groups data for grouped operations.                                              |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`if_else()`               |Creates values based on a binary condition.                                      |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`mutate()`                |Creates or modifies columns.                                                     |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`n()`                     |Returns group size within `summarise()`.                                         |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`rename()`                |Renames columns using `new_name = old_name`.                                     |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`select()`                |Chooses specific columns from a dataset.                                         |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`summarise()`             |Computes summary statistics for groups.                                          |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|magrittr       |`%>%`                     |Passes the result of one operation into the next.                                |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|nycOpenData    |`nyc_311()`               |Downloads NYC 311 Service Request data from NYC Open Data.                       |[Introduction To tidyverse](#sec-loading-packages)|
|tidyr          |`drop_na()`               |Removes rows containing missing values.                                          |[Introduction to tidyverse](#sec-tidyverse-key-functions)|
|base R         |`mean()`                  |Calculates the average of numeric values.                                        |[Comparing Two Groups](#sec-means-key-functions)|
|base R         |`merge()`                 |Joins two data frames together based on a shared key variable.                   |[Comparing Two Groups](#sec-means-key-functions)|
|base R         |`rbind()`                 |Combines multiple data frames by binding rows together.                          |[Comparing Two Groups](#sec-means-key-functions)|
|dplyr          |`inner_join()`            |Performs a SQL-style inner join, keeping only rows that match in both datasets.  |[Comparing Two Groups](#sec-means-key-functions)|
|stats          |`t.test()`                |Tests whether two group means differ significantly.                              |[Comparing Two Groups](#sec-means-key-functions)|
|tidyr          |`pivot_longer()`          |Converts data from wide format to long format.                                   |[Comparing Two Groups](#sec-means-key-functions)|
|tidyr          |`pivot_wider()`           |Converts data from long format back to wide format.                              |[Comparing Two Groups](#sec-means-key-functions)|
|base R         |`plot()`                  |Visualizes post-hoc comparison results.                                          |[Comparing Multiple Means](#sec-anova-key-functions)|
|base R         |`set.seed()`              |Ensures reproducibility when generating random data.                             |[Comparing Multiple Means](#sec-anova-key-functions)|
|stats          |`TukeyHSD()`              |Performs post-hoc pairwise comparisons.                                          |[Comparing Multiple Means](#sec-anova-key-functions)|
|stats          |`aov()`                   |Fits ANOVA models.                                                               |[Comparing Multiple Means](#sec-anova-key-functions)|
|stats          |`rnorm()`                 |Generates random values from a normal distribution.                              |[Comparing Multiple Means](#sec-anova-key-functions)|
|supernova      |`supernova()`             |Displays ANOVA results in structured tables.                                     |[Comparing Multiple Means](#sec-anova-key-functions)|
|base R         |`xtabs()`                 |Constructs contingency tables using a formula interface.                         |[Analyzing Categorical Data](#sec-cat-analysis-key-functions)|
|gmodels        |`CrossTable()`            |Detailed cross-tabulations.                                                      |[Analyzing Categorical Data](#sec-cat-analysis-key-functions)|
|janitor        |`adorn_ns()`              |Displays counts and percentages together.                                        |[Analyzing Categorical Data](#sec-cat-analysis-key-functions)|
|janitor        |`adorn_percentages()`     |Converts counts to percentages.                                                  |[Analyzing Categorical Data](#sec-cat-analysis-key-functions)|
|janitor        |`tabyl()`                 |Creates clean contingency tables.                                                |[Analyzing Categorical Data](#sec-cat-analysis-key-functions)|
|pheatmap       |`pheatmap()`              |Heatmap visualization of residuals or contributions.                             |[Analyzing Categorical Data](#sec-cat-analysis-key-functions)|
|rcompanion     |`cramerV()`               |Measures association strength between categorical variables.                     |[Analyzing Categorical Data](#sec-cat-analysis-key-functions)|
|stats          |`chisq.test()`            |Performs Chi-Square tests of independence.                                       |[Analyzing Categorical Data](#sec-cat-analysis-key-functions)|
|GGally         |`ggpairs()`               |Enhanced scatterplot matrix with correlations.                                   |[Correlation Analysis](#sec-cor-key-functions)|
|base R         |`ifelse()`                |Recodes variables conditionally.                                                 |[Correlation Analysis](#sec-cor-key-functions)|
|base R         |`pairs()`                 |Creates a scatterplot matrix.                                                    |[Correlation Analysis](#sec-cor-key-functions)|
|janitor        |`clean_names()`           |Cleans names of an object.                                                       |[Correlations](#sec-cor-key-functions)|
|ppcor          |`pcor.test()`             |Computes partial correlations.                                                   |[Correlation Analysis](#sec-cor-key-functions)|
|stats          |`cor()`                   |Computes Pearson correlation coefficients.                                       |[Correlation Analysis](#sec-cor-key-functions)|
|stats          |`cor.test()`              |Computes and tests correlations.                                                 |[Correlation Analysis](#sec-cor-key-functions)|
|broom          |`glance()`                |Extracts model-level statistics.                                                 |[Linear Regression](#sec-linear-reg-key-functions)|
|broom          |`tidy()`                  |Tidies model coefficients.                                                       |[Linear Regression](#sec-linear-reg-key-functions)|
|lmtest         |`bptest()`                |Tests heteroscedasticity.                                                        |[Linear Regression](#sec-linear-reg-key-functions)|
|stats          |`AIC()`                   |Compares regression models.                                                      |[Linear Regression](#sec-linear-reg-key-functions)|
|stats          |`lm()`                    |Fits linear regression models.                                                   |[Linear Regression](#sec-linear-reg-key-functions)|
|stats          |`step()`                  |Performs stepwise model selection.                                               |[Linear Regression](#sec-linear-reg-key-functions)|
|base R         |`exp()`                   |Converts log-odds to odds ratios.                                                |[Logistic Regression](#sec-log-reg-key-functions)|
|caTools        |`sample.split()`          |Splits data into training/testing sets.                                          |[Logistic Regression](#sec-log-reg-key-functions)|
|car            |`vif()`                   |Detects multicollinearity.                                                       |[Logistic Regression](#sec-log-reg-key-functions)|
|caret          |`confusionMatrix()`       |Evaluates classification performance.                                            |[Logistic Regression](#sec-log-reg-key-functions)|
|caret          |`varImp()`                |Assesses predictor importance.                                                   |[Logistic Regression](#sec-log-reg-key-functions)|
|pROC           |`auc()`                   |Computes area under the ROC curve (AUC).                                         |[Logistic Regression](#sec-log-reg-key-functions)|
|pROC           |`roc()`                   |Builds ROC curves.                                                               |[Logistic Regression](#sec-log-reg-key-functions)|
|pscl           |`pR2()`                   |Computes pseudo R² values.                                                       |[Logistic Regression](#sec-log-reg-key-functions)|
|stats          |`glm()`                   |Fits generalized linear models, including logistic regression (binomial family). |[Logistic Regression](#sec-log-reg-key-functions)|
|knitr          |`kable()`                 |Creates clean, readable tables for rendered Quarto reports.                      |[Reproducible Reporting](#sec-quarto-key-functions)|
|knitr          |`knitr::opts_chunk$set()` |Sets global chunk options in R Markdown.                                         |[Reproducible Reporting](#sec-quarto-key-functions)|
|reproresearchR |exam_data                 |Exam data dataset.                                                               |[Correlation](#sec-intro-cor)|
|reproresearchR |infection_treatments      |Infection treatments dataset.                                                    |[Analyzing Categorical Data](#sec-intro-cat-analysis)|
|reproresearchR |pizza_prices              |Pizza prices dataset.                                                            |[Linear Regression](#sec-linear-reg)|
